Name: Better Alex's Room
Author: Robin081939
Description:
This mod replaces Alex's green carpet in his spouse room with a dark wooden one (see pictures) - not much more to say than that
Unfortunately, in this mod you still can't change the floor with in-game flooring, but hopefully this is less jarring than the neon horror (you can tell I hate his carpet)
Disclaimer - this is my first mod so if you see any mistakes let me know!

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]
[/size]
